name: Fellow
tagline: Fellow is an AI meeting assistant and team management platform that helps managers run effective meetings. It provides AI-generated meeting agendas, real-time transcription, automated action items, and a performance feedback system. Over 3,000 companies including Shopify and HubSpot use it to make meetings more productive.
